(1) Any  person  who  is  required  by  an  expert  or  a
police  officer  to  make  any  disclosure  or  to  assist  in  an
investigation  under  this  Act,  shall  comply  with  such
requirement.
(2)   A  person  who  obstructs  the  lawful  exercise  of  the
powers conferred on an expert or a police officer or fails to
comply with any reasonable request made by such expert or
police  officer  during  an  investigation  shall  be  guilty  of  an
offence and shall on conviction be liable to fine not exceeding
two hundred thousand rupees or to imprisonment of either
description  for  a  period  not  less  than  one  year  and  not
exceeding two years or to both such fine and imprisonment.
